correctness.rationale: Exact four-chart Jacobian-unit-ideal Gröbner testing of all 4095 forms gives 1116 smooth masks; exhaustive unique pencils give 44070, with 250992 valid pencil extensions counted 28 times per net, hence 8964 nets. Canonical net set gives the same count. All 36 surface automorphisms yield 249 free orbits; all nine rational points give exactly the published 14 spectra. A first-jet map at a rational point proves no dimension-four all-smooth space. Source and compiled checks are included and were executed from the package source.

value.rationale: This completely resolves the extremal projective-net classification for genus-two divisors of natural smallest asymmetric bidegree on a split quadric over the smallest finite field. The 249 orbit count and 14 seven-curve arithmetic spectra are motivated incidence invariants beyond known smoothness/existence results. Exact finite classification is substantive even without a new general theorem.
